title: Parley — Accept Request
description: Request body for POST /api/pact/parleys/{id}/accept (§19.3.2). The accepting handler's Mandate MUST bind to this Parley: session_id non-null and equal to the path id. Mandate-intersection conflicts do NOT refuse the open — the Parley proceeds with a deadlock warning attached (ratified Q2). Added in PACT v2.1 (§19).

mandate.description: The accepting handler's Mandate (§20.2), verified per §20.4.
